- scripts/validate_process.sh:~2260 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The exit-14 message tells users to inspect `validate_generate.log` but does not say where that artifact is stored.
  WHY: The message is helpful, but users still have to infer the workflow-artifact location.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2160-2166 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false` now hard-fails instead of falling back to freehand generation.
  WHY: Other reviewers treated the new behavior as intentional/documented, but it is still a backward-incompatible break for repos that relied on the old fallback.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:320 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Template asset copy failures are silenced by `|| true`.
  WHY: The workflow continues and later renderer failures become harder to trace back to the missing asset copy.
- Overall documentation:— | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: There is no guidance for migrating repos from freehand generation to template mode.
  WHY: Maintainers won't know how to update their repos after the behavior change.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1124,1133 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: Exit code 14 is reused for both the Python-version check and renderer execution failure.
  WHY: The same status code hides which failure happened, so telemetry and troubleshooting lose precision.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:520 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `Install Python dependencies for validation renderer` step still runs even when `VALIDATION_USE_TEMPLATES=false`.
  WHY: That work is wasted on runs that will fail anyway, though one reviewer considered the always-install behavior intentional now that template mode is the default.
- prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt:13 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The prompt mentions `.ai/validate.yml` hints but never says the manifest is required for template mode.
  WHY: That ambiguity can make the model treat the manifest as optional and keep self-healing.
- tests/test_validate_process_template_mode.py:36-45 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The test hardcodes the exact `Template renderer requires python3 >= 3.9` string.
  WHY: Small wording changes will fail the test even when behavior is unchanged.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2232-2340 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3-coder-plus]
  PROBLEM: The renderer-exit handler repeats the same notification/result-writing flow for exit codes 10-15.
  WHY: Repeated blocks are easy to drift and make future changes error-prone.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:525-527 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The pip install step assumes `python3` exists before checking.
  WHY: Hosts without `python3` will fail with a confusing error instead of a clear skip or warning.
